result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline v2.8

disclosed_matters.summary: A logic bug in Boulder deployed on February 13, 2025 could have resulted in revoked certificate entries being removed from the CRL before expiration, but the specific system configuration did not engage the affected code pathways, so CRLs remained complete and compliant.

A configuration change on May 23, 2025 discontinued OCSP URI inclusion in end-entity certificates and caused sample sites to fail on May 24, 2025; the service was restored on May 26, 2025 after investigation.
